Stores shift-wise production and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metrics for each work center or machine. Captures production time, downtime, output quantities, and efficiency measurements for a specific WorkCenter, ShiftDay, and ShiftName combination. Used to monitor operational performance, analyze production losses, calculate OEE components (Availability, Performance, Quality), and track benchmark OEE values throughout the shift.
One record per work center per shift

records.Entry: This table stores hourly production and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metrics for each work center or machine within a shift. It provides a detailed hour-by-hour view of equipment performance by tracking production time, downtime, output quantities, and OEE components for a specific WorkCenter, ShiftDay, ShiftName, and Hour (HH) combination. The table enables manufacturing teams to monitor operational performance at an hourly level, identify production losses, analyze downtime trends, compare hourly productivity, and calculate OEE metrics including Availability, Performance, and Quality.
One record per work center, per shift, per hour

records.Entry: This table stores downtime event history for work centers or machines. Each record represents a specific downtime occurrence against a work center, capturing the downtime event name, start and end times, duration, reason, machine state, and event status. The table provides detailed visibility into production interruptions and supports downtime analysis, root cause identification, loss categorization, and operational improvement initiatives.
One record per downtime event occurrence

records.Entry: For any aggregation across multiple shifts (same day, week, month, custom date range), do not average Availability, Performance, Quality, or OEE from individual shift records. Aggregate the underlying measures first and then recompute the metrics from the aggregated totals.
Any aggregation across multiple shifts: same day, week, month or custom date range.
Aggregate underlying measures first and then recompute Availability, Performance, Quality and OEE.

Availability = SUM(OperatingTimeInSec)/SUM(NetAvailableTimeInSec); Performance = SUM(EarnedHoursInSec)/SUM(OperatingTimeInSec); Quality = SUM(GoodQuantity)/SUM(TotalQuantity); OEE = Availability_ratio × Performance_ratio × Quality_ratio × 100
Single shift/hour uses stored values; benchmark and downtime events use stored event/snapshot values.
